title: Signal: Workspace includes a module from outside the repository
scope: A go.work file that declares a go.work `use` directive that reaches outside the workspace root.
limitations: It matches a go.work `use` directive that reaches outside the workspace root in the parsed go.work; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A go.work that mentions a go.work `use` directive that reaches outside the workspace root in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
